title: Bartram's Garden Community Boathouse
specs: Large public dock with accessible launches
More than 40 species of fish in the Tidal Schuylkill River
Minors must be accompanied by an adult
Volunteers must be at least 18 years old; minors may help with parent/guardian
No previous boating, fishing, swimming, or river experience required
Knowing how to swim is recommended for volunteers
Group boating programs available for community-based groups in Southwest Philadelphia or Grays Ferry by advance contact; no boat rentals or group reservations
includes: All equipment and instruction for kayaking or row boating
Free rods, tackle, bait, and basic instruction for fishing
gap: Exact duration of boating sessions not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy kayaking, row boating, and catch-and-release fishing on the Tidal Schuylkill River. All equipment and instruction are provided for free during public programs. No registration or experience is required, and minors must be accompanied by an adult.
extraNote: Programs may be canceled due to inclement weather or unsafe river conditions · No launch permit needed for non-motorized boats · Public dock at Bartram's Garden · May through October
